description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers DE+EN phrasings for reviewing a Data Processing Agreement against GDPR Art. 28 (controller or processor). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours: NDA triage, generic contract review, privacy-regime read (privacy-review), legal triage.
